generation.scope: Every nonzero weight at every frame with nonzero diagonal entries of its Gram matrix and its inverse is standard Koszul and AS regular, including tangent coordinate pencils. This finite all-degree criterion covers all closed points of a dense open of the nine-dimensional component. The quadratic dual of the common central quotient is the alternating product of graph subspaces in k^4 plus M2. A Koszul filtration from complementary matrix pencils proves regularity in every degree.

open_mathematics: Analyze frames with isotropic coordinate vectors, where rank-one generators have shorter scalar support, and test whether the semisimple model detects exclusions. Global covering and AS membership outside known charts remain open.
